paper_title: Dual Modality-Aware Gated Prompt Tuning for Few-Shot Multimodal Sarcasm   Detection
caption: Effect of Prompt Depth
model_annotation: The plot titled “Prompt Depth vs Accuracy” illustrates how classification accuracy varies with prompt depth for two series (mmsd and mmsd2). The x-axis is labeled “Prompt Depth (J)” on a linear scale, spanning prompt depths from 1 to 11 with tick labels shown at regular intervals of 2 (2, 4, 6, 8, 10), while data points appear at J = 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, and 11. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” on a linear scale, covering approximately 74% to 81% with tick labels at 1% increments. The mmsd series is drawn as an orange dashed line with square markers, starting at about 80.0% at J = 1, staying near 80.3% at J = 3 and about 80.2% at J = 5, remaining around 80.1% at J = 7, rising to about 81.3% at J = 9, and then returning to about 80.1% at J = 11. The mmsd2 series is drawn as a blue solid line with circular markers, beginning around 76.5% at J = 1, dropping to about 74.0% at J = 3, increasing to about 76.0% at J = 5 and about 77.5% at J = 7, reaching about 77.6% at J = 9, and ending near 76.8% at J = 11.
